name: unified-proxy-copilot
description: Route Copilot Chat via providers + model discovery (schema v2) or legacy proxy_configs.json. OpenCode Go usage bar, multi-account, aux vision/web-extract.

unified-proxy-copilot.proxyConfigPath.description: Path to proxy_configs.json file. Defaults to ~/.vscode/proxy_configs.json if not specified. Used to dynamically load available AI backends.

markdownEnumDescriptions: Inject `x-opencode-session` when `base_url` looks like OpenCode Go (`opencode.ai` / `/zen/go`).
Always inject session / client / User-Agent headers on every backend.
Never auto-inject (you can still set `custom_headers` in proxy_configs.json).
unified-proxy-copilot.openCodeSession.markdownDescription: Whether to auto-inject OpenCode Go affinity headers (`x-opencode-session`, `x-opencode-client`, `User-Agent`). Override per proxy with `opencode_session` or `custom_headers`.

unified-proxy-copilot.openCodeSessionId.markdownDescription: Opaque value for the `x-opencode-session` header (any stable string). Default matches `local_openai_forward`. Per-proxy override: `opencode_session` in `proxy_configs.json`.

markdownEnumDescriptions: Token usage only. No diagnostic logs or dumps.
Privacy-safe metadata. Safe to share publicly.
⚠️ Contains sensitive prompt content. For local debugging only.
unified-proxy-copilot.debugMode.markdownDescription: Controls what diagnostic information is logged.

markdownEnumDescriptions: Show status bar when `proxy_configs.json` has an OpenCode Go (`opencode.ai` / `/zen/go`) endpoint.
Always show the usage status bar.
Hide the status bar (commands still work).
unified-proxy-copilot.showUsageStatusBar.markdownDescription: Status bar for OpenCode Go quota (`GET …/v1/usage`: rolling / weekly / monthly %). Click opens **Show Usage**.

unified-proxy-copilot.usageRefreshEveryN.markdownDescription: **Unused (v2.0.18+).** Quota refresh is: once on reload, then every 5 minutes only if OpenCode Go API forwards occurred in that window.

unified-proxy-copilot.usagePollMinutes.markdownDescription: **Unused (v2.0.18+).** Window is fixed at **5 minutes** (refresh only when OpenCode Go forwards were counted in the window).

scripts.clean: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('out', { recursive: true, force: true, maxRetries: process.platform === 'win32' ? 10 : 0 })"
